s9711f93aee54c2: The two-storey tree structure separates the quota group from the leaf business quota. Quota groups are divided by GPU type or level of operational criticality, and the different groups do not borrow resources between themselves by labeling a node. In the same group, the leaf quota can be borrowed in excess of Min's spare capacity; when competition takes place, Max decides on his share. If quota A is twice as much as B, A receives roughly twice as much loanable capacity as B.
